question: Thang-Ta, a classical martial dance form, belongs to which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Thang-Ta** is a traditional martial dance form originating from the northeastern state of **Manipur** in India.
 
• It is deeply rooted in the culture and traditions of the **Meitei community** of Manipur, who have practiced Thang-Ta for centuries.
 
• This martial art combines the use of **swords (Thang)** and spears (Ta), along with unarmed combat techniques.
 
• The dance form is also a demonstration of **physical agility, combat skills, and rhythmic movement**, blending art and martial expertise.
